description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {B}.
Memnite dies, triggering Bastion of Remembrance, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.
